teaser: A review of ESF, Mitko Vasilev's open software factory: a microVM per run, gates by exit code, evidence, and demo videos from the proving run.
core_idea: ESF runs each coding task in its own microVM with deterministic gates and an evidence folder; its newer idea, a demo recorded by the same run that proves the change, is worth copying, alongside gate integrity and per-run sandboxes.
